acquire_container: acquire a new container from the deployment server using a specified image and runtime executable
release_container: release a previously acquired container by its container ID back to the deployment server
execute_in_container: execute a shell command inside an acquired container with optional environment variables and working directory
get_container_status: get the status of all containers and actors managed by the deployment server
managed_container_context: use the ManagedContainer context manager to automatically acquire and release a container for command execution
